items: Bring your partners on with one link.
Share your referral link, and any publisher who signs up through it is auto-approved for your offer, so you can onboard your existing partners in a single step.

On Growth and above, our team runs recruitment campaigns and introduces publishers that fit your brand, real people who know your vertical. **Only the partners you choose come on board, so you stay in control.**
